an8.39:1.1: bhikkhave puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā sovaggikā sukhavipākā saggasaṃvattanikā iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattanti.
an8.39:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti.
an8.39:1.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati. 3.
an8.39:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti.
an8.39:2.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo puññābhisando . . . pe . . . saṃvattati. 4.
an8.39:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti.
an8.39:3.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati. 5.
an8.39:3.3: Pañc' imāni bhikkhave dānāni mahādānāni aggaññāni rattaññāni vaṃsaññāni porāṇāni asaṃkiṇṇāni asaṃkiṇṇapubbāni na saṃkīyanti na saṃkīyissanti appaṭikuṭṭhāni samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
an8.39:3.5: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti.
an8.39:3.6: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato bhikkhave ariyasāvako aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ deti averaṃ deti avyāpajjhaṃ deti;
an8.39:3.7: aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ datvā averaṃ datvā avyāpajjhaṃ datvā aparimāṇassa abhayassa averassa avyāpajjhassa bhāgī hoti.
an8.39:3.8: Idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ dānaṃ mahādānaṃ aggaññaṃ rattaññaṃ vaṃsaññaṃ porāṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇapubbaṃ na saṃkīyati na saṃkīyissati appaṭikuṭṭhaṃ samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
an8.39:3.9: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati. 7.
an8.39:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti . . .
an8.39:5.1: kāmesu micchācāraṃ pahāya kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti . . .
an8.39:7.2: Surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato bhikkhave ariyasāvako aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ deti averaṃ deti avyāpajjhaṃ deti;
an8.39:7.3: aparimāṇānaṃ sattānaṃ abhayaṃ datvā averaṃ datvā avyāpajjhaṃ datvā aparimāṇassa abhayassa averassa avyāpajjhassa bhāgī hoti.
an8.39:7.4: Idaṃ bhikkhave pañcamaṃ dānaṃ mahādānaṃ aggaññaṃ rattaññaṃ vaṃsaññaṃ porāṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇaṃ asaṃkiṇṇapubbaṃ na saṃkīyati na saṃkīyissati appaṭikuṭṭhaṃ samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
an8.39:7.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave aṭṭhamo puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattati.
an8.39:8.1: Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā sovaggikā sukhavipākā saggasavattanikā iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantī
